name.zh: 伪俄挺俯卧撑（指尖朝外）

purpose.zh: 指尖朝外的伪俄挺俯卧撑，练肩前侧、前锯肌和直臂前倾力量，手腕比指尖朝后的版本更好适应
purpose.en: A pseudo planche push-up with the fingers turned out to the sides. Builds front-shoulder, serratus and lean strength with an easier wrist angle than the fingers-back version.

text.zh: 指尖朝外，先往前倾，肩在手前面再往下放
text.en: Fingers out, lean first, shoulders ahead of your hands, then lower

text.zh: 手放在腰两侧，指尖朝向身体外侧，不要朝脚的方向。
text.en: Hands by your waist, fingertips pointing out to the sides, never back toward your feet.

text.zh: 屈肘时手肘贴着身体往后，推起时把地推开。
text.en: Elbows go straight back along your body; push the floor away as you press up.

text.zh: 脚尖踩住垫子，从头到脚跟一条线，别塌腰也别撅屁股。
text.en: Toes planted, head to heels in one line; no sagging, no piking.

commonErrors.zh: 只下放不前倾，肩回到手的正上方
commonErrors.en: Lowering without the lean, shoulders back over the hands.
Turning the fingers back toward the feet.
Flaring the elbows out to the sides.

cautions.zh: 手腕承重很大，先活动手腕；疼就停或减小前倾
cautions.en: Heavy load on the wrists: warm them up; stop or lean less if they hurt.

training.source: flare2 r3 2b animation tempo = r1 (4 s per rep: 1.5 s down, 0.3 s bottom, 1.2 s up, 1.0 s top)

flare2.item: Flare2：伪俄挺俯卧撑新版（指尖朝外 45–90°）
flare2.camera: 正侧面（看清肩超过手掌多少）；俯视/正前看指尖朝外
flare2.doseBrief: 表：同 r1 伪俄挺俯卧撑；草稿 6 次 × 3 组、休 90 秒（待定）
flare2.note: Animation r3 2b: the r1 pseudo planche push-up (shoulders ~12 cm past the wrists at the top, ~19 cm at the bottom, elbows 88 deg, feet roll over the toes) with the fingers turned OUT ~72 deg (r1 ~100 deg, slightly back). 8 s loop = 2 reps, symmetric.

reminders.zh: 手肘贴身体，身体一条线
reminders.en: Elbows in, body in one line
